name: boc_get_common_indicators
description:
Latest values of several headline Canadian indicators in one call (one Valet request per indicator), from the Bank of Canada Valet API (no API key).
Returns: indicators keyed by name (series_name, label, value, date, description, or an error) and last_updated.
Inputs (none required): indicators (array of 1-14 of usd_cad, eur_cad, gbp_cad, jpy_cad, cny_cad, policy_rate, overnight_rate, prime_rate, bond_2y/5y/10y/30y (30y is the long-term benchmark), cpi, core_cpi (CPI-trim); default usd_cad, policy_rate, bond_10y, cpi).
For history use boc_get_series; for a single value boc_get_latest.
Example: {"indicators": ["usd_cad", "policy_rate", "bond_2y", "bond_10y"]}

indicators.description: Specific indicators to retrieve. If omitted, returns default set of key indicators (usd_cad, policy_rate, bond_10y, cpi).
Key economic indicators with their latest values

error.description: Error message if this indicator could not be retrieved

last_updated.description: Timestamp when this data was retrieved (ISO 8601 format)

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Batch operation that retrieves multiple indicators in one call. More efficient than calling boc_get_latest multiple times. All values share the same retrieval timestamp.

examples.description: Get default economic dashboard (4 key indicators)

usd_cad.label: US dollar, noon spot rate, Canadian dollar, daily
usd_cad.description: US Dollar to Canadian Dollar Exchange Rate

policy_rate.label: Target for the overnight rate (business daily)
policy_rate.description: Bank of Canada Policy Interest Rate

performanceNotes.batchEfficiency: Retrieves N indicators with N API calls but returns consistent timestamp
performanceNotes.vsIndividualCalls: Same API calls as calling boc_get_latest N times, but unified response format
performanceNotes.recommendation: Use for 2+ indicators to get consistent snapshot timestamp
performanceNotes.errorHandling: Individual indicator failures don't stop other indicators from being retrieved

defaultIndicators.rationale: Most widely watched FX rate for Canadian economy
